## A DAG

```{r}
dag2 <- dagitty("dag {
  E -> C
  C -> A
  A -> D
  E -> A
  E -> D
  C -> D
  G -> A
  G -> D
  S -> A
  S -> D
}")

coordinates(dag2) <- list(
  x = c(E = 1, C = 2.8, A = 4.6, D = 6.4, G = 5.5, S = 5.5),
  y = c(E = 1.5, C = 1.5, A = 1.5, D = 1.5, G = 0.3, S = 2.7)
)

curve2 <- list(
  "E->A" = c(0, 0.6),
  "C->D" = c(0, -0.6),
  "E->D" = c(0, -1.3)
)

dag_plot(dag2, curve = curve2, shrink = 0.2, pad = 1.3)
text(1,   -0.85, "Ethnicity",     col = "firebrick", font = 3, cex = 1.3)
text(2.8, -0.85, "Childhood SEP", col = "firebrick", font = 3, cex = 1.3)
text(4.6, -0.85, "Alcohol",       col = "firebrick", font = 3, cex = 1.3)
text(7.3, -1.5,  "Accidents",     col = "firebrick", font = 3, cex = 1.3)
text(5.5,  0.15, "Age",           col = "firebrick", font = 3, cex = 1.3)
text(5.5, -3.15, "Sex",           col = "firebrick", font = 3, cex = 1.3)
```

## Danish smoking has declined from 21% (2010) to 11% (2025) {.smaller}

```{r danish-smoking-data, include=FALSE}
theme_blue <- "#377eb8"
theme_red  <- "#ED1B2F"

edu_levels <- c("Grundskole*", "Gymnasial/erhvervsfaglig*", "Kort videregående",
                "Mellemlang videregående", "Lang videregående")

dk_rate <- tibble::tribble(
  ~education,                  ~y2010, ~y2025,
  "Grundskole*",                 30.5,   19.7,
  "Gymnasial/erhvervsfaglig*",   24.9,   13.5,
  "Kort videregående",           21.7,    9.9,
  "Mellemlang videregående",     15.8,    8.3,
  "Lang videregående",            9.0,    4.4
) |>
  mutate(education = factor(education, levels = edu_levels)) |>
  pivot_longer(c(y2010, y2025), names_to = "year", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(year = if_else(year == "y2010", "2010", "2025"))

dk_share <- tibble::tribble(
  ~education,                  ~y2010, ~y2025,
  "Grundskole*",                13.3,   10.4,
  "Gymnasial/erhvervsfaglig*",  40.5,   34.7,
  "Kort videregående",          12.6,   10.7,
  "Mellemlang videregående",    22.1,   27.8,
  "Lang videregående",          11.5,   16.3
) |>
  mutate(education = factor(education, levels = edu_levels)) |>
  pivot_longer(c(y2010, y2025), names_to = "year", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(year = if_else(year == "y2010", "2010", "2025"))

dot_plot <- function(dat, x_limits, x_lab, show_labels = TRUE) {
  offset <- diff(x_limits) * 0.035
  dat <- dat |>
    group_by(education) |>
    mutate(
      is_max      = value == max(value),
      label_x     = value + if_else(is_max, offset, -offset),
      label_hjust = if_else(is_max, 0, 1)
    ) |>
    ungroup()

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = value, y = fct_rev(education))) +
    geom_line(aes(group = education), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 3) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = year), size = 6) +
    geom_text(aes(x = label_x, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", value), colour = year, hjust = label_hjust),
              size = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("2010" = theme_blue, "2025" = theme_red)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  if (!show_labels) p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
  p
}
```

